div.div: Gemini image output never contains text: all on-screen text is set in code, so Indic scripts are shaped correctly and locked regions are never redrawn by a model. Measured on Vertex AI: one Tamil Nadu key visual with 4 Tamil TTS lines cost about USD 0.07; a Lyria jingle was a 32.8 s 48 kHz WAV in 29 s.
